'''Enhance Attribute''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]]-based [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to increase a physical attribute for a limited time, allowing them to [[Force jump/Legends|jump higher]], [[Force speed/Legends|move and react faster]], [[Force punch|strike harder]], [[Magnify Senses|see and hear better]], [[Soft to Solid|resist more damage]], [[Force Body|be stronger]], and the like. Novices could only enhance one attribute at a time, while a proficient user could boost five at once and for a longer duration.<ref name="DFRSP" />

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] thought that every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] should be able to use this power to gain the strength and brawn to use [[Form V/Legends|Form V lightsaber combat]].<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force real-life book">''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|The Jedi Path]]''</ref> Sidious used this power when [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|fighting]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]], only barely successful in conjuring into his body the strength to withstand their physical might.<ref>''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>
